description: This file contains implementation of core file system classes and functions, including File, Directory, and Partition management, with platform-specific code for Windows and POSIX systems.

classes.name: File
classes.description: Represents a file with methods to load file info, normalize paths, and manage file attributes.

classes.name: Directory
classes.description: Represents a directory with methods to create, check existence, and manage directory permissions.

classes.name: Partition
classes.description: Represents a disk partition with methods to read partition info and handle mount points.

methods.name: File::Normalize
methods.description: Normalizes a file path, removing redundant separators, dots, and handling scope.

methods.name: File::LoadFileInfo
methods.description: Loads file attributes, size, and timestamps from the filesystem.

methods.name: Partition::ReadPartitionName
methods.description: Reads the device name associated with a partition from system files (Linux).

methods.name: Partition::LoadPartitionInfo
methods.description: Loads partition size, free space, and device name.
